answer: Challenge-chain bond: each identity locks 80 credits, posting a relic-sealed link on the dune ledger. Each epoch a fresh challenge forges the next link; a basalt seal binds key to prior hash, one key per chain. Auditors replay the chain: copied link, reused seal, or missed epoch breaks it and burns the bond. Link one 45, later links +9: 1,000 fakes cost 4,540,500, locking 80,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents spend 45 once, keep the bond.
